verse.verse_1: We have indeed revealed this (Message) in the Night of Power:
verse.verse_2: And what will explain to thee what the night of power is?
verse.verse_3: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
verse.verse_4: Therein come down the angels and the Spirit by Allah's permission, on every errand:
verse.verse_5: Peace!... This until the rise of morn!
